title: An agent that emails customers directly
prompt: A partner-built agent drafts and sends customer-facing email autonomously on a schedule. What is the governance gap?

options.text: There is no approval or validation step before the write, and no defined behaviour for low-confidence cases.
options.feedback: Correct. Approvals and validation belong before writing to a system, and explicit error handling with a defined fallback is required.

options.text: The agent uses a schedule trigger, which is unsafe by nature.
options.feedback: No. Schedule-based triggers are a documented advanced capability. The gap is the missing approval gate, not the trigger.

options.text: Nothing, provided the model is large enough.
options.feedback: No. Model size is not a governance control.

takeaway: Escalation boundaries are design decisions made before launch, not incident responses made after.
